title: papermotion
description: Make short animated films in the papermotion paper-cutout engine: everything generated by code (no image models or assets), characters rigged with bones, springs and strands, physics, parallax sets, choreography with beats, multi-shot edits, weather and film finishing, rendered offline to MP4. Use when asked to create, extend or polish a papermotion scene, short, story, demo, character, set or camera work, or to add engine features for one.
